name: study-river
description: Printable A4 worksheets from any theme: picture vocabulary, kana/kanji and alphabet tracing, Japanese vertical reading, questions with answer keys, arithmetic, fractions, algebra, mazes, and sudoku. 会話で選んだテーマを、印刷できるA4学習プリントに。

interface.shortDescription: テーマから印刷用A4プリントを作成
interface.longDescription: Create printable worksheets from conversationally authored content. Kinds: picture words with about 2,000 bundled monochrome pictures (trace, write, match, cards) in any language, kana/kanji tracing, alphabet handwriting, Japanese vertical reading (comprehension, reading aloud, copying), text questions with answer keys, arithmetic incl. column form and decimals, fractions, 100-square grids, algebra and equations, mazes, and sudoku. Mathematical answers are checked exactly. Requires host Python with ReportLab (and Pillow for pictures); no MCP or Study River API.
defaultPrompt: 好きな動物の名前で、ひらがなのなぞりプリントを作って
Make an English picture-word sheet with 12 kitchen words to trace.
Hazme una hoja con 8 divisiones largas y sus respuestas.
